products.name: Microsoft 365 Email Authentication — SPF, DKIM & DMARC — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement SPF, DKIM & DMARC for Microsoft 365 — scope SPF, enable EXO DKIM signing, roll DMARC monitor→quarantine→reject on aggregate reports, and align third-party senders — so your domain can't be spoofed and stays deliverable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Authenticate your Microsoft 365 mail and stop domain spoofing

If your domain isn't authenticated, attackers spoof it and your legitimate mail lands in spam. This solution implements email authentication for Microsoft 365: publish and scope SPF, enable DKIM signing in Exchange Online (and for on-prem/hybrid senders), and roll DMARC from monitor to enforcement (p=none → quarantine → reject) using aggregate reports — plus alignment for third-party senders — so your domain is protected and deliverable.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — SPF/DKIM/DMARC and alignment, the EXO DKIM model, third-party sender handling, and the monitor→enforce journey.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO + accepted domains, DNS control, inventory of legitimate senders, admin roles).
  • Implementation Guide — inventory senders, publish/scope SPF, enable DKIM signing, publish DMARC at p=none, review aggregate reports, then move to quarantine and reject — pilot-first, without breaking legitimate senders.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (SPF/DKIM pass, DMARC aligned, reports reviewed before enforcement) plus Best Practices for safely reaching p=reject.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A Microsoft 365 domain that can't be spoofed and lands in the inbox — SPF scoped, DKIM signing on, DMARC enforced on real report data, third-party senders aligned — authenticated and deliverable.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-EmailAuthPosture.ps1 — Read-only email-authentication posture discovery across all Exchange Online accepted domains
    • Get-SpfLookupHealth.ps1 — SPF scope/health helper — read-only; recursively resolves an SPF record, counts the real DNS lookups
    • Invoke-DmarcReportAnalysis.ps1 — Parse and analyze DMARC aggregate (RUA) reports — read-only; summarizes each sending source and
    • Set-DkimSigning.ps1 — Enable or rotate Exchange Online DKIM signing for accepted domains — SAFE BY DEFAULT (dry-run /
    • Test-EmailAuthAlignment.ps1 — Validation report for email authentication — read-only; checks SPF scope, DKIM validity, and DMARC

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
